reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for a trail runner aiming to become faster. While both plans involve a similar total training time, Plan A incorporates a tempo run, which is crucial for improving speed and lactate threshold – a key factor in trail running performance. Plan B focuses almost exclusively on aerobic runs and strength work, which are important but don't directly address speed development. The inclusion of a longer run in Plan A also provides valuable experience with sustained effort on trails, building endurance and mental toughness.
